cohort: 104 pregnant women with polyhydramnios between 2005 and 2013, all with normal first trimester fasting glucose and normal glucose challenge test
finding: Diagnosis of third trimester polyhydramnios was not associated with increased risk for GDM or neonatal complications.
birth_weight: No significant difference in birth weight between groups (3437 ± 611 vs. 3331 ± 515 g, p = 0.63)
